03 — BEFORE YOU SIGN

Six things we check before you sign.

Six points, in writing, on every Berlin lease.

I
The rent brakeMietpreisbremse

At signing the rent may not exceed the local comparative rent by more than ten percent, exceptions aside. We check, furniture surcharge included.

II
Who may charge youBestellerprinzip · §34c GewO

Whoever orders the agent pays. One you hire is paid only once you sign, within a legal cap. We open with a licensed partner.

III
The depositKaution

At most three months' cold rent, in three instalments, kept apart from the landlord's money. Anything more is not legal.

IV
Cold or warmKaltmiete · Warmmiete

The listed rent is often cold. We read the Nebenkosten advance, what it covers, and what the yearly settlement can add.

V
RegistrationAnmeldung · Wohnungsgeberbestätigung

You register within two weeks of moving in; the landlord owes you the confirmation form. We make sure it comes with the keys.

VI
The dossierSCHUFA · Selbstauskunft

Landlords want SCHUFA, payslips, proof of no arrears, ID. Newcomers lack the German ones. We build the file so it reads right.

04 — QUESTIONS

The questions we get asked.

Why isn't BOOM taking searches in Berlin yet?
Brokering a flat in Germany needs a trade permit (§34c GewO), and the law sets how a tenant-side agent is paid: only once you sign, within a cap. We open with a licensed partner. Your file waits, ready.
Which service will be mine?
Full Search (€500) if you haven't started. Application Pack (€199) if you've found one and need to apply, or you have a shortlist and you're already in Berlin. Attended Viewing (€149 per viewing) if you have a shortlist and you're still abroad. Not sure: open a file, we advise. List prices. Full Search due only once you sign a lease; the other plans charged only when the desk opens.
What can you do for me today?
Open your file, answer your questions the same working day, and tell you honestly what your budget buys in Berlin, warm and cold. The prices on this page are set; nothing is charged before the desk opens, and the Full Search fee only once you sign.
Is my rent capped in Berlin?
Berlin applies the Mietpreisbremse: at signing the rent may not exceed the local comparative rent by more than ten percent, with exceptions for new builds, modernised flats and a higher previous rent. Furnished flats hide a lot in the surcharge. We check.
Do I need to be in Berlin?
No. When the desk opens, a BOOM person attends viewings in your place, with live video and a written report. The lease is read and signed remotely. You arrive for the keys and the Übergabeprotokoll.
Who pays the agent in Germany?
Whoever orders the agent. A landlord's agent cannot charge you. An agent who brokers your tenancy may charge you only once the lease is signed, at most two months' net cold rent plus VAT. Full Search opens under that rule; Application Pack and Attended Viewing are charged at opening.
What do you do with my data?
It is used to answer you and to open your file, and for nothing else. No resale, no mailing lists. Ask us to delete it and we will.
